listing.name: Targeting Feed Slowdown Fix
listing.summary: This is a small quality of life mod that fixes the rendering slowdown issue some graphics cards have with the Targeting Feed system of the Heron. It will remove the shield glow effect but maintains the weapons glow aboard shielded fighters to preserve visual identification when the system is active.
listing.aiSummary: Fixes rendering slowdowns with the Heron's Targeting Feed by removing shield glow effects.
